lines: 「我的脑海中有两棵树，一颗是绿色的，一颗是灰色的。」
林砚坐在屋檐下的台阶，看着院子里的老树，又感受着自己脑海深处那株诡异的怪树。
神情有些恍惚！
脑海中的怪树由一绿一灰两棵树缠绕而成。
一道嫩绿，生机盎然；一道灰败，形如槁木。
唯一相同的地方是，不管是绿枝还是灰枝，都没有任何树叶。
光秃秃的，高度不过三寸。
穿越成迅哥儿了？
林砚轻叹一声，在确认了自己魂穿之後，他的脑海中就多出一道关於这颗树信息。
武道树，顾名思义有武道有关。
很简短的一段信息。
脑海多出武道树，林砚接受得也很坦然，这年头穿越没有金手指等於白穿。
小开就是金手指，大开就是挂。
啪！
有鸟粪落在脸上，将林砚放空的思绪拉回。
视线扫向周围的土坯院墙，眼神带着好奇。
大运这是把自己给干到哪里来了？
脑海中的记忆不断流转，有前世三十多年的，也有原身主人的。
前世的他小镇出生，读书，就业，在大厂当牛马。
一眼就能够看到老。
他想改变，可35岁的他，无论是想做什麽，都被说太晚了。
当他不顾所有亲朋劝阻，辞掉工作，骑着张雪机车游历祖国大好河山时，被一辆失控的大运撞上。
大运临身的那一刻，林砚脑海中想到第一个念头不是吾命休矣，而是这次再也没有人会说太晚了。
35岁的人，干什麽都太晚，唯有离世会被说走的太早了。
原身少年的记忆：
登州府，广平县。
十八岁，父母双亡，跟随婶婶和小弟生活。
所有的记忆并非走马观花过一遍，而是就好像醍醐灌顶一般，瞬间灌输在了他的脑海中。
现在林砚可以确定，大运给他干到了一个武道世界。
「原身，有些惨啊。」
祖父祖母连面都没见过便已经离世，七岁那年父母遭遇山洪意外而亡，此後跟着叔叔婶婶生活，十二岁那年叔叔服徭役再无消息。
没有父母双亡，法力祭天的戏谑。
回想着原身的经历，林砚内心也是涌现淡淡的悲伤。
不知道是不是因为占据了原身身体的原因，还是受到原身灵魂深处的感染。
content_en:
"There are two trees in my mind, one is green and the other is gray."
Lin Yan sat on the steps under the eaves, looking at the old trees in the yard, and feeling the strange tree in the back of his mind.
He looks a little dazed!
The strange tree in my mind is made up of two trees, one green and one gray.
One side is green, full of vitality; the other side is gray, shaped like a gnarled tree.
The only thing that is the same is that neither the green branches nor the gray branches have any leaves.
It was bare and no more than three inches tall.
Have you traveled through time and become Brother Xun?
Lin Yan sighed softly. After confirming that his soul had penetrated, an additional piece of information about this tree appeared in his mind.
The martial arts tree, as its name suggests, is related to martial arts.
A very short message.
There were many martial arts trees in his mind, and Lin Yan accepted it calmly. Without a golden finger, time travel would be in vain these days.
A small opening is a golden finger, a large opening is a cheat.
Snap!
Bird droppings fell on his face, which brought Lin Yan's thoughts back to his mind.
He glanced at the surrounding adobe courtyard walls with curiosity in his eyes.
Where did Universiade get himself?
The memories in my mind are constantly flowing, including those from the past life of more than thirty years, and those of the original owner.
In his previous life, he was born in a small town, studied, worked, and worked as a cow and horse in a large factory.
You can see the old one at a glance.
He wanted to change, but at the age of 35, no matter what he wanted to do, he was told it was too late.
When he ignored the dissuasion of all his relatives and friends, quit his job and rode Zhang Xue's motorcycle to travel the great rivers and mountains of the motherland, he was hit by an out-of-control Universiade.
The moment the great fortune approached, the first thought that came to Lin Yan's mind was not that my life was at stake, but that no one would say it was too late this time.
At the age of 35, it is too late to do anything. Only death will be said to be too early.
…
Memories of the original boy:
Dengzhou Prefecture, Guangping County.
At the age of eighteen, his parents died and he lived with his aunt and younger brother.
…
All the memories were not just reviewed briefly, but were instantly instilled in his mind like an enlightenment.
Now Lin Yan can be sure that Universiade has brought him to a world of martial arts.
"The original body is a little miserable."
My grandparents passed away without even meeting each other. When I was seven years old, my parents died in a flash flood accident. After that, I lived with my uncle and aunt. When I was twelve years old, my uncle started working as a corvee and there was no news again.
There is no joke about parents dying and mana sacrificing to heaven.
Recalling his original experience, Lin Yan also felt a touch of sadness in his heart.
I don't know if it's because of occupying the original body, or if it's infected deep in the original soul.
